link.note: Real man (Dwyer Branch 1) but wrongly attached in the tree as Andrew H. Heffernan's father; the correct father is Thomas Heffernan b. 1808.

summary: Not John's ancestor: the 1791 Thomas Heffernan the tree mistakenly put above Andrew H. Heffernan.
bio: Dwyer's Branch 1: Thomas 'of Lanespark', baptized 1791, son of Patrick Heffernan and Catherine Neagle, married Catherine Shelly in 1831. The tree's 'Thomas Heffernan 1791-Deceased' (obituary clipping image) attached to Catherine Boney conflates him with Thomas of Mardyke (b. 1808).
sources: Michael Dwyer, Heffernans of Slieveardagh (Welsh Hill Press, 2020), Branch 4 (and Branch 3), working from the Killenaule and Gortnahoe Catholic parish registers: https://archive.org/details/heffernans-of-slieveardagh
Johnny Meier's Ancestry tree (screenshots IMG_7791-7840 in John's Google Drive), transcribed in research/tree_transcription.md and Ancestry tree screenshots (section 2.2.2)
